goals.title: Deliver Mission Control v1
goals.objective: Turn Mission Control into a Codex-driven operations system with a dense holographic holo-table UI and a production-quality 3D asteroid facility pipeline.
constraints: No fake autonomy or fake visibility.
Codex channel runtime owns execution for now.
External generation and public/deploy actions require review.
Preserve existing visual work unless a sub-goal explicitly replaces it.
3D asset pipeline updates go to Discord channel 1477048876669075578.
Do not launch paid Meshy generation while the 2100-credit lane cap remains closed.
successCriteria: User can inspect real goal/task/event state from Mission Control.
Holo-table presents dense operational state with fewer tab hops and kanban task flow.
Asteroid baseline passes a high-fidelity quality gate before facility population continues.
Facility visualization uses accepted Meshy/library assets by role, with visual proof and truthful keep/reject decisions.
verification: Browser smoke test after interactive console work lands
stopRules: Stop before paid external generation unless approved.
Stop before deploy/public actions unless approved.
Stop on architecture ambiguity that would force a broad rewrite.

goals.title: Backend State/Event Model
goals.objective: Create the local canonical state and event model that the Mission Control UI can read.
constraints: Start local and inspectable.
Demo rows must be explicitly marked.
successCriteria: Canonical local state file exists.
State includes agents, goals, goalRuns, events, tasks, reviews, artifacts, facilityAssets, visualReviews, and telemetry.
Existing app reads from canonical state with fallback to legacy seed state.
stopRules: Do not add cloud dependency for v1 state.

goals.title: Holographic Command Console
goals.objective: Clicking the central command table opens a real Mission Control interface bound to canonical state.
constraints: Functional panels first.
No decorative HUD spam.
Preserve existing scene.
successCriteria: Central console/table is clickable.
Overlay opens/closes cleanly.
Overlay panels render canonical goals, agents, tasks, reviews, telemetry, deployment events, and facility buildout.
stopRules: Stop before public deploy actions unless approved.

goals.title: Agent Roster + Assignment Logic
goals.objective: Model agents as operational workers and let the command console recommend and locally assign tasks based on skills, trust, load, availability, and risk fit.
constraints: No fake persistence.
Local assignment actions must label themselves as browser-session-only.
Demo agents must remain explicitly marked.
successCriteria: Agents appear in the command console.
Tasks/goals can be assigned locally.
Agent state drives the facility/console UI without pretending persistence.
stopRules: Do not wire persistent writes until the event bridge goal lands.

goals.title: Local Event Bridge Foundation
goals.objective: Persist local preview assignment events and task/agent patches across browser refreshes without claiming backend/OpenClaw event ingestion.
constraints: Label persistence as browser-localStorage only.
Do not claim real-time backend ingestion.
Keep canonical JSON as the base state.
successCriteria: Local assignment events survive refresh.
Local task/agent patches are merged over canonical state.
Console exposes local bridge status and reset control.
stopRules: Stop before adding backend credentials or public webhook endpoints.

goals.title: Holo-Table Density + Kanban Tasks
goals.objective: Run the overlay-specific Mission Control command console loop in #dashboard: dense single-page information, fewer tab hops, goal-lane visibility, and kanban-style task state independent of 3D asset progress.
constraints: Keep UI state-backed.
No fake backend actions.
Avoid tab sprawl; default to one dense operational surface.
Overlay work must remain inspectable through ?overlay=1&console=overview without waiting on the heavy 3D scene.
successCriteria: Primary console exposes goals, agents, telemetry, review, buildout, and task kanban on one page.
Tasks render in kanban columns.
Reference-inspired holographic styling improves without hiding operational data.
stopRules: Stop before broad visual rewrite that breaks current Pages inspection.

goals.title: High-Fidelity Asteroid Baseline
goals.objective: Select or generate a high-poly asteroid shell/cutaway baseline before populating the facility with more generated assets.
constraints: Audit existing local high-poly/source candidates before spending.
Michael approved reopening the Mission Control Meshy lane up to the 4000 credits/month account limit on 2026-05-18.
3D progress updates go to channel 1477048876669075578.
successCriteria: Current baseline is audited against strongest existing candidates.
A high-fidelity asteroid source asset is selected or one paid Meshy candidate is generated with approval.
Accepted baseline has Blender source and optimized GLB path.
stopRules: Stop before paid Meshy generation without explicit budget approval.
Stop if Meshy key/credential access is unavailable.

goals.title: Meshy Facility Library Population
goals.objective: Populate the accepted asteroid baseline with the existing Meshy/generated facility library so it reads like the concept-art facility.
constraints: Do not scatter props; place assets by facility role.
Every install pass needs visual proof and keep/reject/demote decision.
Start only after the asteroid baseline is accepted.
successCriteria: Facility population uses accepted library assets by role.
Scene communicates command, hangar, production, service, and signal functions.
Each population pass has a visual review board and explicit decisions.
stopRules: Stop if baseline asteroid has not passed quality gate.
goals.blocker: Meshy-101 runtime candidate still needs Mission Control browser/in-scene load proof and final baseline acceptance.

goalRuns.summary: Mission Control v1 operating-system goals are locally implemented: canonical state, holographic console, assignment scoring/actions, local preview persistence, durable event ingestion, review gates, goal intake/selection, and live filesystem event bridge. Remaining work is broader AAA facility buildout and deployment review.
Canonical local state model, validator, runtime adapter, and existing dashboard dock/readout binding are in place.
goalRuns.verificationSummary: Passed node scripts/validate-mission-state.mjs, node --check app.js, and HTTP checks for index/app/state. Browser localhost navigation was blocked by OpenClaw browser policy, so visual smoke was not run.

goalRuns.summary: Added a clickable central console hotspot, Holo-table dock opening path, holographic overlay shell, state-backed panel tabs, close/backdrop/Escape behavior, and a QA query param for console-open screenshots.
goalRuns.verificationSummary: Passed node --check app.js. Headless Chrome rendered the console overlay on desktop and mobile; renderer fallback keeps the state UI available when WebGL context creation fails.

goalRuns.summary: Added assignment scoring, recommendation panels, local assign buttons, local event emission, and telemetry refresh for browser-session assignment actions.
goalRuns.verificationSummary: Passed node scripts/validate-mission-state.mjs, node --check app.js, headless Chrome task console screenshot, and DOM checks for assignment recommendations/actions plus agent fit scores.

goalRuns.summary: Added browser-localStorage event bridge foundation for local assignment events and task/agent patches, plus telemetry/reset UI.
goalRuns.verificationSummary: Passed node scripts/validate-mission-state.mjs, node --check app.js, and headless Chrome telemetry DOM checks for local bridge status.

goalRuns.summary: Overlay lane is split into #dashboard with kanban, dense overview, explicit goal lanes, and an overlay-only inspection mode; final holo-table compression still remains.
Meshy-101 hollow v2 is browser-runtime proven and remains the active local candidate, but final baseline acceptance is blocked on one no-spend Blender cleanup pass for interior cut artifacts.

tasks.title: Create canonical local state/event model

tasks.title: Build clickable holographic command console

tasks.title: Persist local assignment events across refresh

tasks.title: Compress holo-table into a dense single-page operations surface

tasks.title: Inventory Meshy facility library by role

tasks.title: Prove Meshy-101 runtime candidate in Mission Control scene
